'''Rod Latham Mains Manipulator (Rod Latham))''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds81.htm Mains Manipulator (Rod Latham))], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
